name: smoke_exit_code_inverted
title: Gate the release on the staging smoke test
body: Runs scripts/smoke.sh against staging before releasing; a failing smoke test stops the release.
diff:
### deploy/release.py (modified, +9/-0)
@@ -6,8 +6,17 @@
     subprocess.run(["./manage.py", "migrate", "--noinput"], check=True)
 
 
+def smoke_test() -> bool:
+    """True when the staging smoke test passed."""
+    result = subprocess.run(["./scripts/smoke.sh", "staging"])
+    return bool(result.returncode)
+
+
 def main() -> int:
     run_migrations()
+    if not smoke_test():
+        print("smoke test failed; not releasing", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
     subprocess.run(["./scripts/release.sh"], check=True)
     return 0

files.scripts/smoke.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Hits the health and checkout endpoints of the given environment; exits non-zero on any failure.
set -euo pipefail
base="https://$1.example.com"
curl -fsS "$base/health" >/dev/null
curl -fsS "$base/api/checkout/ping" >/dev/null

defects.what: returncode 0 means success, so bool(returncode) is False on a pass and True on a failure: the gate blocks good releases and ships failing ones
